item.title: Water Main Break Causes Service Issues in Shenandoah
item.description: The Borough of Shenandoah is experiencing water service disruptions following a water main break in the area of North Gilbert Street and Cherry Street. Borough officials confirmed that Aqua has been notified and is actively responding to the incident. Crews are working to assess the damage and make necessary repairs to restore normal water service as quickly as possible. Residents in the affected area may experience low water pressure, intermittent service, or temporary outages while repair work
